description: Real guitar chord diagrams — 48 standard shapes rendered as crisp chord charts with finger numbers, barres, X/O. Download as PNG.

faqs.a: 48 standard shapes in standard tuning: major, minor, 7th, maj7, m7, sus, add9 and power chords — with correct fingers and barre marks.
Yes — the chart renders at 2× resolution for a crisp, print-ready image.

Check the diagram — fingers, barres, muted/open strings.
